ngaap.guidance: FY2026 (11-Feb-2026): sales $12.19-$12.49bn; adjusted EPS $10.05-$10.45 (+12.0% to +16.5%); includes Dellner Couplers (closed 10-Feb-2026); slide 18: adjusted operating margin up, tax rate ~24.5%, capex ~2% of sales, tariffs as of 10-Feb-2026; release graphic: cash conversion >90% through 2029. GAAP EPS not guided.
ngaap.notes: Adjusted results exclude restructuring & portfolio optimization costs, transaction costs, inventory purchase-accounting (step-up) charges and non-cash amortization expense. EBITDA = op income + other income (expense) + D&A; Adjusted EBITDA adds restructuring & transaction costs (as labelled in the release; the Adjusted EBITDA add-back can differ from restructuring+transaction op-level items because it is defined separately).
